authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full gakṣa gives Nepali/Bengali gāch, Assamese gās, Oriya gacha and Maithili gachiā tree. These support selected eastern affricate/sibilant tree forms and ordinary vowel endings. Source aspiration, nasalization and vowels remain intact; exact local developments and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. The grove senses of some gāchī comparanda do not change the survey tree gloss. Exact response: goc.
